mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with bumetanide (loop diuretic) increases risk of severe hypertension through sympathomimetic potentiation and hypokalemia-induced arrhythmias; bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion exacerbates MAOI cardiovascular effects.
action: Avoid this combination if possible; if necessary, use alternative diuretic and monitor blood pressure closely, check electrolytes frequently, and ensure patient avoids tyramine-rich foods and sympathomimetic agents.
